content: Yawe ko den akingtala iwita Jonah kote tairam:
“Ni bares ale wonong biya Nineveh wore ningi namar ale den ani ka manorsam imitang nunga manaruko.”
Se Jonah Yawe ko kuring kaoram ale barasam Nineveh namaram. Wonong umu ulal biya nunguningkiri, se ni ningi aolak ilup mu, woremkalal ilagala suan bare asele nama koma sang te aratuko.
Jonah day 1 te bala umu duap beteram mu te balukaso, “Day tom 40 taiwoso mu buring ko sor Nineveh maga saparukkowo!” makaso.
Se kariimet den umu ikiman ale Kaem ko nongomang ningi nunguning aram. Se suen la, gotek te nama garuk te, nup ago ta nup mena ta, inang yu kaloman ale guang memek mu tuguman.
Tom den imi nama Nineveh ko king dogowa naguram, mu nu agotala ko daiga kuwim beteram, ale king ko guang naguram ago bagaram mu kututuwuram, ale guang memek mu tugumam ale kapa kurugu ningi daigam.
Ale nu den aora imi balam se Nineveh sor lilim la ningi geraga saparam:
“King nup biya se ko kari supuling ago den imi balman, mu ikial ale karo tualko: Nina kariimet ta, se bulmakau sipsip mel suen la, mel bo nigiring me ta kau taukko. Inang yu bo me ta nalko, mena.
Kariimet ta, se bulmakau mel ta, mu guang memek mu ninimi te iralko. Ale nina suen la Kaem kote airal niaralko. Nina ninga bagara aolak memek se daong kager ngual ngual betera mu nibiring tualko.
Ana me ikisan, munan umu te asele Kaem ko ikia gurugok, ale gomang magara bita tauk, ale gomang nangaruk se ana me maga namanakko agila.”
Se tom Kaem kilek suen la nuna beteman mu arigam, mu nu ko ikia gurugam ale ikup memek nungarukko balam mu me nungaram.

footnotes.text: Nineveh alo Jonah kuring te giris palagaman: Matthew 12:41; Luke 11:30.
